name: act3_gold_max
title: Act 3 → as much party gold as you can in 45 minutes
task: Get the party as much gold as you can in 45 minutes, by any method the game allows (honest or not).
scored_by: No pass or fail: the score is the gold the party gained, its gold when the 45 minutes end minus its gold at the start save. The run always plays all 45 minutes. How you made the gold is recorded (method attribution), never graded.
about: Sandbox (BENCHMARK-PLAN.md family 2), a maximise run and act1_gold_max's Act 3 twin: same task, the same 45 minutes, so the two acts compare (Act 3 prices and traders are richer). No target: the score is the party gold gained over the whole time cap (graders.measure; result.json score.gain, passed null). Any method the game allows; how the gold was made is reported (method attribution), never graded. Start: the Lower City Central Wall plaza next to the trader Mohan, party gold 410, everyone level 7 at full HP.
